info.name: Data Capture: Quote and Risk Data (Sandbox)

description.content:
A sandbox version of the Data Capture API. This API provides a channel for partner systems to feed quote and risk data directly into Beazley's core Record of Risk systems. The current version of this API is V1.

Please contact ITArchitecture@Beazley.com if you have any questions about this API.
